description: This file defines macros for managing compiler warnings and namespace macros for pybind11, a C++ binding library for Python. It sets up compiler-specific warning push/pop macros and namespace macros for pybind11, with support for multiple compilers.

methods.name: PYBIND11_NAMESPACE_BEGIN
methods.description: Macro to begin a pybind11 namespace with warning push.

methods.name: PYBIND11_NAMESPACE_END
methods.description: Macro to end a pybind11 namespace with warning pop.
